name: 30783-singledecode-qwen34bawq-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node, sm90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One engine, one GPU, no sharding of any kind.
architecture: Qwen3ForCausalLM dense decoder: 36 layers, hidden 2560, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads at head_dim 128, MLP intermediate 9728, float16, weights published in 4-bit AWQ (gemm, group_size 128, no module excluded). The rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=1, bounded at 240 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup 2.5% and cooldown 2.5% (6 requests each, both pinned to `mode: requests`).
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets, static seed 30783, `request_format: plain` with `temperature: 0.0` (greedy). Prompt EXACTLY 1024 tokens and output EXACTLY 128 (min = max = both), freshly sampled per request, so nothing is shared between requests.
purpose: A single-user coding assistant on one H100, streaming 128-token replies to 1024-token prompts, one request at a time.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-4B-AWQ
quantization: awq
tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
max-num-seqs: 1
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.4
